issues.issue: Hidden transfer recorded as revenue. Exhibit D (p4) Other Governmental Funds prints Transfers 212,840.80 = School Nutrition 80,000 (p13) + Cooperative 87,840.80 (p17) + 45,000. That 45,000 must be the Activities fund's, because Other local receipts 437,383.21 leaves 219,689.93 for Activities, and 288,004.13 = 219,689.93 + contributions 23,314.20 + 45,000. The General fund 8000 Transfers (125,000) = 80,000 + 45,000 is recorded as other financing, but the Activities side is counted as receipts. Fix: add a -45,000 revenue contra line in Activities (split_from, review) and a +45,000 other financing line. As it stands, the detail other-financing lines net to -45,000 instead of 0.
